title: Change your company accounting reference date (AA01)
text:
Use this form to change an accounting reference date. It must be received within the period allowed for laying and delivering the accounts for the current or the immediately previous accounting reference period.

 Use the online service to update your information as quickly as possible. It takes longer to process paper forms sent to us by post.

 If you’re filing this form for an overseas company with a UK establishment, you must send the paper form by post to the correct Companies House office .

 We’ve stopped sending paper letters to confirm when your accounting reference date has changed. You can search for your company to check your new accounting reference date.
changeNote: Added wording for overseas companies with a UK establishment. They must send the paper form by post to the correct Companies House office.
